items.quote: 7:22 And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 7:23 Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses to tell the children of Israel not to eat any kind of fat from oxen, sheep, or goats.
items.object: fat of ox, sheep, or goat
items.mechanism: a divine command passed on by Moses to the children of Israel
